Package simulation

Interface AdjustablePriorityQueue<E>

Type Parameters:
E - the type of elements in this queue
All Superinterfaces:
Collection<E>, Iterable<E>
All Known Implementing Classes:
BinaryHeap
public interface AdjustablePriorityQueue<E> extends Collection<E>
An adjustable priority queue that supports efficient updates to element priorities. This interface extends PriorityQueue to add the ability to update the priority of an element that is already in the queue. This is useful for algorithms like Dijkstra's shortest path that need to update priorities during execution.
